<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_SubsequentEventsTextBlock', window );">Subsequent Events</a></td>
<td class="text"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;line-height:1.15;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">11. Subsequent Events</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;line-height:1.15;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">October 2026 Private Placement</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;line-height:1.15;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">On October 15, 2026, we entered into a securities purchase agreement (the &#8220;October 2026 Purchase Agreement&#8221;) with certain investors (the &#8220;October 2026 Investors&#8221;), pursuant to which we agreed to issue and sell an aggregate of </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">6,106,870</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> shares of our common stock (the &#8220;Offered Securities&#8221;) to the October 2026 Investors, at a purchase price of $</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">32.75</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> per share (the &#8220;October 2026 Private Placement&#8221;). The aggregate gross proceeds to us from the sale of the Offered Securities were approximately $</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">200</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> million, before deducting placement agent fees and other offering expenses.</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;line-height:1.15;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The October 2026 Purchase Agreement contains customary representations, warranties and agreements by the Company, customary indemnification obligations of the Company to the Investors and other obligations of the parties.</span></p><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;line-height:1.15;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The October 2026 Private Placement closed on October 19, 2026 (the &#8220;Closing Date&#8221;). </span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">At the closing of the October 2026 Private Placement, we entered into a registration rights agreement (the &#8220;Registration Rights Agreement&#8221;) with the October 2026 Investors. Pursuant to the Registration Rights Agreement, we are required to file or confidentially submit a registration statement with the SEC covering the resale by the October 2026 Investors of the Offered Securities as promptly as reasonably practicable, and in any event no later than 30 days following the Closing Date. The Company filed such resale registration statement on October 26, 2026.</span></p><span></span>
</td>

<tr><td><div class="body" style="padding: 2px;">
<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>The entire disclosure for significant events or transactions that occurred after the balance sheet date through the date the financial statements were issued or the date the financial statements were available to be issued. Examples include: the sale of a capital stock issue, purchase of a business, settlement of litigation, catastrophic loss, significant foreign exchange rate changes, loans to insiders or affiliates, and transactions not in the ordinary course of business.</p></div>
